title: Ski Slope WtE

excluded_sources.reason: grey render of the old LEGO model

gate_a.note: The variant has no usable street view: variant_0.png is a grey render of the old LEGO model. The oblique and roof views agree and are the authority. A person must rule on this before activation, as for the concert hall, the crescent and the laneway.

measurement_contract.scale_basis: No image carries a scale. The main block in the roof view (294 by 780 px) is set to 60 by 159 m (0.204 m/px), matching the catalogue's suggested 160 m length. Heights come from a pinhole camera fitted to eight points of the block in the oblique (8.2 px RMS) with the plan held fixed: summit parapet 80.2 m, low-end parapet 39.5 m, wing roof 29.8 m. A wing roof below 20 m fits clearly worse (12.5 px RMS at 20 m, 26 px at 5 m). The east parapet is one straight line from the low end to the summit.

oblique: High view from the south-east over the wings toward the harbour.
Long block in light aluminium bricks; its whole roof is one green turf slope rising north, with a stepped path and a glass guard down each side and a rounded low end.
East face: tall slot windows glowing warm in staggered columns, and a climbing wall with large blue and yellow volumes on a pier standing proud of the face.
Summit: a lower terrace with tables in front of a glazed bar, an upper terrace with a glass guard, a pavilion and plant behind; the side walls rise to the summit corner.
Lower green-roofed wings in aluminium brick in front of and beside the low end; a tall twin-flue stack to the west.
top: Main block 294 by 780 px with rounded corners; turf 234 px wide between two stepped paths.
Summit at the north: an upper terrace with string lights, a pavilion 210 px wide and a plant enclosure; a lower terrace with tables; short flights at each side between them.
A pier 26 by 140 px on the east face 230 to 372 px from the top.
Green-roofed wings west and south-east of the block, with hatches; the west wing narrows to a strip 58 px wide that runs north to 220 px from the top; the stack in the west wing.

source_conflicts: variant_0.png, the street view, is a grey render of the old LEGO model, not a picture of this building. It is excluded; the oblique and roof views govern. Needs a ruling by a person.

The roof view draws the stack leaning, its flue about 30 m north-west of its base; the oblique shows it upright and further east. The base position from the roof view governs; the height, about 100 m, comes from the oblique camera.
The catalogue suggests a 160 by 70 m footprint. The images show the 60 by 159 m block with wings that make the whole 103 m wide; the images govern.
hidden_assumptions: The west and north faces are not seen; they carry the same slot windows, and the north face two roller doors for the plant's deliveries (inferred).
The wings' southern end lies outside both images; they are drawn ending 16 m south of the block.
Interiors are schematic: each slot window has a lit room face 0.9 m behind its outer face; the bar and pavilion have shallow lit interiors; the plant itself is not modelled.
The harbour, ships, cranes, neighbouring sheds, roads, vehicles and people belong to the site and are not modelled.

roof_contract.form: one straight turf slope from the low end to the summit terraces, stepped paths beside it, a parapet with a glass guard; terraces, pavilion and plant at the summit
roof_contract.weathering: the slope, paths, terraces and parapets close the roof completely

tall warm slot windows in staggered columns
a climbing wall on a pier of the east face
terraced summit with bar and pavilion
lower green-roofed wings and a tall twin-flue stack
